conviction_note: The evidence nets to roughly nothing. On one side is a crowded short (17.8-24% of float) in a stock 70% off its high and 3% above its 52-week low, which bounced 12-18% from a similar setup in Nov 2025. On the other side are a floating-price convertible signed 2026-10-30 that creates mechanical selling, an unconfirmed Batam GPU go-live that the Q4/FY guide depends on, and a name that sold its last raise-and-beat by 11%. So p_up is 51 on a ~14% absolute move. impact_sum (+0.9) is a little more positive than the scaled number because the single positioning finding is sized larger than any individual negative.
bar: Company guide for Q3 2026 revenue is US$48-50m (raised from 36-40m), Q4 is US$60-70m, and FY2026 is 'at least US$200m'. Sources: H1 2026 6-K exhibit https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001903145/000143774926028827/ex_974012.htm and 247wallst 2026-08-25 for the Q4 range https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/25/gorilla-sinks-11-despite-guiding-2027-revenue-up-to-29-above-consensus-evolv-technologies-and-ambarella-tick-up/. Sell-side consensus comes from one source only: Benzinga's forecast page shows Q3 rev US$51.9m, EPS -$0.22 and Q4 rev US$75.8m (snapshot about Oct 13; https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/GRRR/earnings-forecasts). The Nasdaq row has EPS -$0.24. Because consensus has a single source, findings that turn on consensus sitting above the guide are capped small. Note that the guide ranges are internally inconsistent: 78.4 + 50 + 70 = 198.4 < 200.
positioning_check: Short interest is ~4.84m shares, 17.8% of float, 7.5-10.6 days to cover, at FINRA settlement 2026-09-30 (equibles aggregator, https://equibles.com/stocks/grrr/shortinterest, via the sweep). A second, undated aggregator figure of 24.14% of float short appears in a search snippet. No skew: the chain is unusable (1-day expiry, ATM IV 520%, spread 159% of mid). Put/call OI ratio is 0.66 and total OI 8,536. Tape: spot 6.63 (intraday 2026-11-19), -7.9% over 5d, -18.6% over 20d, -69.6% from the 52-week high, +3.1% above the 52-week low, 20d realised vol 144% (about 9.1% a day). The short is crowded, so negatives were shrunk.

findings.finding: Crowded short into a capitulated tape. 17.8% of float short (Sep 30; one undated source says 24%), 7.5-10.6 days to cover, stock -69.6% from its 52-week high and 3% above the low. At the comparable Nov 2025 Q3 print (oversold, RSI ~28, short interest only ~6%), an in-line quarter plus a new guide sent the stock up nearly 18% after hours.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 Q3 print from an oversold tape: +~18% after hours (+12% per Simply Wall St). Aug 2026 H1 print after a +43% month-long run-up: -9% after hours and -11% the next session despite a guide raise. So the tape going in has decided the sign at the last two prints.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is not a fact the price absorbs. It is the mechanism by which a non-negative print moves the price. If the shorts had already covered, short interest would have fallen and the stock would not still be pinned at its low.
findings.independence: Short interest from https://equibles.com/stocks/grrr/shortinterest (2026-09-30 settlement). The tape is from the sealed baseline. The Aug 2026 contrary case is from https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/25/gorilla-sinks-11-despite-guiding-2027-revenue-up-to-29-above-consensus-evolv-technologies-and-ambarella-tick-up/

findings.finding: On 2026-10-30 the company closed US$25m net (US$27.78m principal, zero coupon, due 2027-10-29) of senior convertible notes plus Series D warrants. The notes convert at the lesser of US$17.53 and 90% of the average of the 3 lowest daily VWAPs over 20 days, with a US$3.86 floor. Another US$75m tranche is subject to mutual agreement, and a shareholder vote (within 75 days, so by about 2027-01-13) would raise authorised shares from 73.5m to 200m against 27.5m outstanding. The proceeds go to advance payments for committed data-centre capacity and the equity portion of GPU purchases. At 6.63 the market cap is ~US$182m, against June 30 cash of US$179m, US$125m of 7.5% notes and US$228m of committed equipment purchases.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 US$125m convertible was followed by a 28% fall (coincentral). The stock fell from ~US$10 in mid-October to 6.63 after this note closed.
findings.why_not_priced: The terms are public and largely priced through the slide. What the market cannot see yet is Q3 cash burn, whether the US$75m second tranche is being drawn, and the September 30 cash balance against the US$228m of commitments. Those arrive with the release and on the call. Floating-price holders convert and sell, which keeps pressure on the price through the window. What the money buys: GPU deployment for a contracted, if unnamed, US$2.5bn customer at NeutraDC Batam. That use is corroborated, so the sign is mildly negative rather than distress.
findings.independence: Shares outstanding 27.51m from https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/grrr/. Notes and commitments from 247wallst 2026-10-12, https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/12/gorilla-sinks-9-as-data-center-pivot-keeps-selling-off-bigbear-ai-dips-palantir-slips/. Cash from the H1 6-K.

findings.finding: The Q4/FY guide rests on the Batam GPU go-live, and I found no public confirmation that it happened. The ~1,000 B300-server Phase 1 (~US$1.3bn over 5 years, ~US$65m a quarter at run-rate) of the US$2.5bn GPUaaS contract was targeted for September 2026. Q4 is guided at US$60-70m, and consensus has US$75.8m. If the go-live slipped, the 'at least US$200m' FY guide (already more than the sum of the quarterly ranges) is at risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Mar 2026: the stock fell 7.5% to a 10-month low when the US$1.4bn Freyr contract moved to a phased rollout, a revenue-timing issue. Aug 2026: it fell 11% on 2027 guidance that excluded unfinalised deployments.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus Q4 revenue (US$75.8m) sits above the top of the company's US$60-70m range. If the market had priced a slip, estimates would have come down toward the guide. The stock at its 52-week low suggests the price is more sceptical than the estimates. This is an absence of confirmation, not a document showing a slip, so it is kept small.
findings.independence: Phase timing (Sept 2026, Dec 2026, H1 2027) comes from DCD, https://datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/gorilla-technology-secures-25bn-gpuaas-contract-in-indonesia (snippet only, 403). The Telkom counterparty finding below points the other way on the site build.

findings.finding: Counterparty: Telkom Indonesia said in October 2026 that construction of the NeutraDC data centre is not affected by water or power issues. NeutraDC said in June 2026 that the Batam BTM-1 facility was fully committed before launch and that it is accelerating expansion. This is the site behind Gorilla's 18MW-by-November capacity and the B300 deployment.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior reaction on a counterparty statement. The guidance line itself has moved the stock 7-11% at past prints.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an Indonesian-language counterparty statement that the US tape does not read. But it covers site construction, not Gorilla's GPU commissioning, so it is a proxy for the Q4 line and is sized small. Snippet only (403 on fetch).
findings.independence: The June 2026 NeutraDC release, https://www.neutradc.com/news/60643/data-center-fully-secured-before-launch-telkom-indonesia-accelerates-expansion-of-neutradc-capacity-in-batam. This bears on the same line as the Batam go-live finding.

findings.finding: The Q3 reported quarter is guided at US$48-50m, raised in August from US$36-40m. Single-source consensus is US$51.9m, about 4% above the top of the guide. Q2 (US$50.1m) beat the company's own upgraded target because milestones finished early, which risks some pull-forward out of Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue beats have not been paid. Aug 2026: an H1 beat and a guide raise sold off 11%. Nov 2025: revenue in line, and the stock rose on the guide instead.
findings.why_not_priced: The quarter sits inside a guided range the market was told to expect, so it is small by construction. The only open question is whether the early Q2 milestones hollowed out Q3.

findings.finding: Possible upward revision to the 2027 target. In August the CFO said guidance includes only contracted revenue with a fixed amount and date, so the US$450-500m 2027 target excludes some NeutraDC servers and part of Yotta Phase 2. The CEO said targets would be revised once those deployments are finalised. The Yotta India programme was announced as moving into physical execution on 2026-09-08.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 2026: a 2027 target 16-29% above consensus still sold off 11%, so this name has not paid for a long-dated target.
findings.why_not_priced: A revision is conditional on deployments being finalised, and the market has discounted long-dated targets. This is an inference from management's stated method, not a document.

findings.finding: The non-binding LOI for a first US data centre (6MW now, path to 36MW) targets completion by end-November 2026. Financing is undisclosed, and the plan is a 100MW+ US portfolio in 12-18 months. An update (definitive agreement plus financing terms, or a delay) is likely on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The LOI announcement on 2026-10-09 drew -10% that day and a 29% slide over the month (247wallst).
findings.why_not_priced: The price, the deal financing and whether the deal adds to the US$75m toxic tranche are all unknown. The market punished the plan itself, so more capital commitment is more likely read negatively.

findings.finding: Northland Securities (Buy, US$40 target in early October) lowered its Q1 2027 EPS estimate in a 2026-11-13 note, the week before the print.
findings.why_not_priced: It is on the wire and mostly priced. It hints that the covering analyst sees a slower ramp or higher costs into 2027.

findings.finding: A multi-year Taiwan criminal-investigation AI contract worth 'tens of millions of dollars' was announced 2026-09-22, with implementation running from Q4 2026 through Q4 2027 plus three years of support.
findings.why_not_priced: It is contracted and probably already inside the guide, given the CFO's method. Small.

findings.finding: Fitch assigned a first-time long-term rating of B- with a positive outlook (report dated 2026-08-24, released 2026-08-27). It said the constraint is access to power and GPUs, not demand.
findings.why_not_priced: It is old and public. It matters only as context for the project-finance debt behind the 70%-debt-funded GPU build.

outside_window.finding: Shareholder vote to raise authorised shares from 73.5m to 200m, required within 75 days of the 2026-10-30 note closing.
Completion of the US data-centre acquisition, targeted for end-November 2026 (only an update can land in the window).

baseline_tension: The baseline carries no skew and no history. The run-up (-18.6% over 20d, at the 52-week low) and a crowded short argue for an upside reaction, while the financing and guide-timing findings argue down, so the evidence is roughly balanced and p_up sits at 51.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (absence is not a cause): the Batam go-live finding rests on no confirmation rather than a document showing a slip, so it went from -2.0 to -1.0.

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the toxic convertible funds GPU deployment for a contracted customer, corroborated by NeutraDC's capacity, so it went from -1.5 to -1.0. It stays negative because the floating conversion price means mechanical selling.
Lesson 7 (crowded short): 17.8-24% short interest kept the negatives small; the +2.0 positioning finding is unchanged.
Lesson 1 (this name sells beats; Aug 2026 -11% on a raise): the reported-quarter finding went from +0.5 to +0.3 and the 2027 revision from +0.8 to +0.5.
Lesson 6 (single-source consensus): sizes that depend on consensus exceeding the guide are capped small. The bar is anchored to the company guide.
Lesson 5 (proxy small): the Telkom counterparty finding went from +0.7 to +0.5.
p_up moved from 48 to 51 once the crowded short was weighed against the negatives, so expected_move went from -0.56 to +0.28.
